stories.title: Buccaneers explode in third quarter in win over Cowboys
stories.summary: Undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels and Tampa Bay held off Dallas on "Thursday Night Football."

stories.title: LeBron on 10-point Sixers debut: Still adjusting, but 'the game is the game'
stories.summary: LeBron James, who joined the 76ers this summer, had 10 points, five assists and four rebounds in the first half of his debut with Philadelphia.

stories.title: Guardians show 'no quit' makeup, send ALDS back to Cleveland for Game 5
stories.summary: Jose Ramirez delivered again, homering and driving in three runs Thursday night to help the Guardians beat the White Sox 9-5 to send their ALDS to a decisive Game 5.

stories.title: Prescott irked by stadium worker's callout after Cowboys' loss at home
stories.summary: Cowboys quarterback Dak Prescott took exception to a stadium worker who yelled "embarrassing" to him as he walked to the locker room after Thursday night's 24-16 loss to the Bucs.

stories.title: Aces' Wilson wins 5th MVP, says she'll nix pregame ceremony to focus on Game 3
stories.summary: Las Vegas Aces center A'ja Wilson won a record fifth WNBA Most Valuable Player award but said she will not participate in a pregame ceremony to receive her trophy because she wants to focus on Friday's Game 3.
